title: Network Architecture & Isolation
description: Establish and maintain network architecture segmentation and defense-in-depth perimeter boundaries between cloud workloads.

title: Network Security & Ingress Filtering
description: Network traffic to virtual interfaces must be restricted via security group firewalls, eliminating open 0.0.0.0/0 administrative and database ports.

title: Default Security Group Zero-Trust Configuration
description: Default network access controls must deny all ingress traffic until explicit business exceptions are granted.

title: User Access Entitlements & Role Definition
description: Enforce strict role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring identities possess only the least privilege necessary.

title: Privileged User Management & Separation of Duties
description: Restrict wildcard administrative access over cloud infrastructure and segregate duties between developers and operators.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
description: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) must be enforced for all users accessing cloud management consoles and administrative APIs.

title: Credential Lifecycle & Key Rotation
description: API keys and programmatic credentials must undergo periodic automated rotation not exceeding 90 days.

title: Access Restriction & Source Verification
description: Administrative sessions must be restricted by network origin IP allowlists and strong credential authentication.

title: Data Inventory & Public Access Prevention
description: Identify and classify sensitive cloud storage data assets and prohibit unauthorized anonymous public internet read access.

title: Data Integrity, Backup & Versioning
description: Enable object versioning and immutable retention to protect critical storage data from accidental deletion or malicious tampering.

title: Sensitive Data Ingress & Egress Boundaries
description: Protect database and storage endpoints from direct public internet exposure through private endpoints and strict firewall rules.

title: Data at Rest Encryption
description: Cloud data at rest must be encrypted using strong cryptographic algorithms (AES-256) with customer-managed keys.

title: Cryptographic Key Lifecycle Management
description: Maintain full customer control over cryptographic root keys using dedicated Hardware Security Module (HSM) services (IBM Key Protect).

title: Audit Trail Provisioning & Region Coverage
description: Activity logging must be systematically activated across all operational cloud regions to record identity transactions and management operations.

title: Audit Log Scope & Integrity
description: Ensure cloud audit logs capture all administrative API transactions and cannot be altered or disabled by unauthorized entities.

title: Immutable Log Storage & Archiving
description: Forward activity logs to an immutable storage target (IBM Cloud Object Storage) for guaranteed regulatory retention.

title: Security Incident Detection & Alerting
description: Configure real-time notifications for anomalous or high-impact security misconfiguration events across cloud infrastructure.

title: API & Interface Perimeter Protection
description: Prevent public exposure of web management portals and constrain CORS headers to validated origins.

title: Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery Controls
description: Implement data replication, object versioning, and backup protections to ensure rapid recovery from destructive ransomware incidents.
